caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #50: ANACHRONISTIC

anachronistic (adjective): out of its proper time period.

✅ In a sentence: A wristwatch on an actor in a film about ancient Rome would be anachronistic.
✅ Similar: out of place in time, outdated
✅ Remember it: ana- (against) + chronos (time).
